name: Peterborough Open 2017
information: You must pay the entry fee online via the button on the [UKCA site](http://www.ukca.org/competitions/upcoming-competitions/peterborough-open-2017/registration) before your registration is approved. This fee is non-refundable, as it represents a commitment to attending the competition. There is a competitor limit of 80. Registration opens at 19:00 on Thursday 12th January and will close at midnight on Sunday 19th February.
